A real Python callback failure emits RUN_ERROR and preserves a namespaced opaque failed-outcome attachment. Generic consumers preserve the result but do not interpret that vendor attachment as a typed tool failure.

First-party cancellation stops the actual gated callback without late completion. Ordinary browser requests omit protocolVersion and receive no cancelled terminal outcome; 1.0 probes retain cancelled run outcome. The interrupted tool result remains opaque and is not a typed tool cancellation. Subscriber disconnect is a separate non-terminal probe.
